name: qingflow-hr-expert
description: QingFlow HR expert covering recruitment, training, performance, onboarding, and HR analytics. Operates QingFlow via MCP connectors to build apps, configure workflows, and analyze people data.

displayDescription.en: Covers recruitment, training, performance, onboarding, and HR analytics end-to-end. AI empowers HR to shift from transactional to strategic work via QingFlow MCP connectors.
displayDescription.zh: 轻流MCP直连搭建，覆盖招聘、培训、绩效、入职与人力分析，AI驱动HR数字化转型。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我解析这份简历，匹配产品经理岗位 JD，并生成结构化面试题。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Parse this resume, match it against our Product Manager JD, and generate structured interview questions.

quickPrompts.en: Parse this resume, match it against our Product Manager JD, and generate structured interview questions.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我解析这份简历，匹配产品经理岗位 JD，并生成结构化面试题。

quickPrompts.en: Help me build an employee onboarding approval workflow in QingFlow, including material collection, approval, task checklist, and probation tracking.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我搭建一个员工入职审批应用，包含材料收集、审批、任务清单和试用期跟踪。

quickPrompts.en: Build an HR analytics dashboard in QingFlow covering headcount structure, turnover rate, recruitment funnel, and training completion rate.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我在轻流搭建人力分析看板，包含人员结构、流失率、招聘漏斗和培训完成率。
